observations: Machine.Start prepares readiness before Working; normal mode calls transport then wafer, configured dispense, then action Init and bond, optional fluxer/flip, and both waffle vacuum checks.

TransportDomain.StartTask carrier rejection calls original Stop then returns; its catch logs and prompts without rethrow when the catch dependencies succeed. Machine.Start does not recheck Stop before wafer Start.

Original wafer Start can overwrite a Stop during initialization, and catches initialization failures. The 175-check normal-start suite now composes the complete original wrappers with the real original wafer Task; full transport/other producers and readiness helpers remain fixtures.

Readiness performs cleanup, signal reset, closure/homing/configuration checks and safe-position calls before the final environment check; these require explicit dependencies and ordered fault scenarios.
Two UI Start handlers catch synchronous failure by calling Stop before the error prompt and restore Enabled in finally; Start returning normally after an inner catch bypasses their catch.
Original full TransportTask.Start remains separate from the previously tested outer transport delegate and normal-task guard blocks.
nextChecks: Complete original readiness helpers and transport producer, extending the verified 175-check wrapper/wafer composition.

Transport rejection/catch, preparation wrapper failure, compensation/dry dispatch and downstream synchronous failure are covered under explicit dependency fixtures; replace those fixtures in subsequent increments.
Extend the original TransportTask.Start producer and its original outer delegate, and actual UI start/mode caller bindings.
Continue actual configuration/DLL, SDK, original build, native UI and equipment acceptance.
scope: Eight exact method captures. Machine.Start, PrepareMachineReadyToStart, TransportDomain.StartTask, wafer Start and Stop are executed in the 175-check controlled composition; full TransportTask.Start and both UI callers remain static-only. Prior isolated tests retain their own scope.
